narrative:
Shipping velocity: nothing has shipped yet. One request is on record, opened on Nov 3, and it is still at the planning stage (about 10%). There is no ask-to-ship time to measure.

## Design a YAML storage backend for tinydb (Nov 3)

The owner opened with a single ask. The ops team wants to hand-edit tinydb database files, so they asked for a YAML storage beside JSONStorage. The agent was to read how the existing storages are built and explain how it would build a YAML one. That explanation had to include which YAML library and loader it would use.

The owner also said not to write it yet. They want a design discussion first. Memory holds no observations for the conversation, so it shows no design, code, PR or release. The request stays in progress at the exploring and planning stage.

## What this teaches so far

There is too little history to draw conclusions about pace, rework or stalls. The one clear signal is how the owner wants to work: agree the approach, including library and loader choice, before any implementation begins.
